headline.text: L1 S4 THG belt peeling found at *unknown start time* — surface smoothed, ATP passed, monitoring continues.

summary: Four foreign-material events across L1 and L3: belt peeling on S4, two plastic incidents on ML4 trial, and a broken bolt on S2 (all pieces accounted for). One ATP failure and one labeling catch rounded out the 24 hours.

holds.title: Quarter-pallet rework — wrong header version
holds.summary: All S2 first-shift quarter pallets flagged for rework after operators validated V1 headers that were miscoded as shrouds in IMS; V2 headers required.
holds.status: Open — full first-shift output held pending header replacement.

food_safety.title: THG belt peeling on S4
food_safety.summary: Belt #1 and #2 surfaces found peeling at 03:58; unclear when peeling started; maintenance removed peeled areas, smoothed surface, ATP passed (11 RLU), line will monitor for recurrence.
food_safety.status: Resolved after cleaning and ATP — monitoring for continued peeling.

food_safety.title: Broken bolt on S2 melting tank #1 lid
food_safety.summary: Bolt fractured on melting tank #1 lid at 09:49; both pieces located and accounted for before production resumed.
food_safety.status: Resolved — both pieces recovered, maintenance replaced bolt.

food_safety.title: Plastic shavings from mold scraper on ML4
food_safety.summary: Plastic shavings found on trial run at 16:08, traced to scraper blade for mold sides; QA collected FM samples, maintenance adjusted blade clearance to stop contact; not touching product inside molds.
food_safety.status: Resolved — scraper adjusted, bin cleaned, startup complete.

food_safety.title: Second plastic FM on ML4 sweco
food_safety.summary: Different plastic texture found on southwest sweco at 20:36, distinct from earlier scraper shavings; texture suggests buffer-tank cleaning brushes as source.
food_safety.status: Open — investigation ongoing into brush source.

quality.title: Wrong Yamato recipe on MFM
quality.summary: Recipe in system did not match 15.03-oz bag spec; new recipe created at 08:22 to correct weight and flavor ratios.
quality.status: Resolved — new recipe validated and running.

quality.title: Incomplete coating on ML4 trial product
quality.summary: Peppermint-cup trial run showed parts with incomplete back coating and some units missing mint filling; in-line inspections continuing to dial in process.
quality.status: Open — trial run optimization in progress.

quality.title: Truffle-line X-ray rejections without cause
quality.summary: X-ray rejecting intermittently since 04:00, no metal confirmed on product, sensitivity under review; no hold required.
quality.status: Open — investigating sensitivity and intermittent trigger.

quality.title: Incorrect date format on ML1 pouches
quality.summary: Operator caught wrong lot-code format during startup checklist at 06:57, line stopped, QA notified, correct format entered before resuming.
quality.status: Resolved — corrected before any product released.

sanitation.title: ML2 hand-pack belt ATP failure
sanitation.summary: Blue hand-pack belt failed ATP at 318 RLU due to chocolate residue at 22:03; maintenance reports belt cannot be disassembled for deep cleaning.
sanitation.status: Open — design limitation preventing thorough cleaning.

sanitation.title: S2 metal detector salt buildup
sanitation.summary: Repeated metal-detector stops traced to salt accumulation under belt; maintenance added slight tension to reduce spike, notes extensive buildup remains.
sanitation.status: Open — temporary fix applied, deep clean recommended.

sanitation.title: ML1 shaker area received dirty
sanitation.summary: First-shift operator reported shaker area not cleaned to standard at shift handoff 06:59.

opportunities.text: Consider adding THG belt surface inspection to S4 startup checklist — today's peeling had unknown start time, echoing design gaps flagged on other visual-wear items.
Review hand-pack belt design on ML2 — ATP failure at 318 RLU cannot be remedied due to non-removable construction, suggesting replacement or redesign needed.
Add sensor centerline-mark verification to MFM changeover checklist — second shift left sensors out of position, caught only after startup delay.
